Read [README.md](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). C++ MinGW DLL → `%TEMP%\go-mapi\` JSON → Go native host → React/TypeScript extension → Gmail API. Local-first, privacy-focused, cost-conscious; MinGW, React Bootstrap, JSON files.

**Build/test:** `npm run build` (or `npm run build:interceptor|native-host|extension`); `npm run test`. Always test with debug build: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`

**Interceptor** (`src/interceptor/`): Zero external dependencies (no nlohmann/json - hand-rolled JSON). Target Simple MAPI spec only (not Extended MAPI/COM). Non-blocking - return immediately to caller. Thread-safe - multiple apps may call simultaneously. `main.cpp`, `mapi_impl.cpp`, `json_writer.cpp`, `fs_utils.cpp`. Test with multiple calling applications (Explorer, PDF viewers, etc.). Check for memory leaks and thread safety.

**Native host** (`src/native-host/`): `main.go`, `protocol.go`, `watcher.go`; length-prefixed JSON types `email`, `removed`, `ready`, `process`, `delete`. Run `gofmt` before committing. Test native messaging with the extension. Handle filesystem edge cases (deleted files, permission errors).

**Extension** (`src/extension/`): `manifest.json`, `src/background/service-worker.ts`, `src/popup/App.tsx`, `src/types/messages.ts`. Use React Bootstrap components for UI. Keep service worker minimal - offload to popup when possible. TypeScript strict mode is required. Test in both Chrome and Edge.

Keep related code together; Avoid utility-first CSS: No Tailwind. Use message catalogs or i18n libraries for user-facing strings. Technical documentation remains in English. Comment the "why", not the "what". Document non-obvious constraints. Keep comments concise. Full schema: [docs/json-schema.json](docs/json-schema.json).

**Workflow:** Read relevant source; run existing tests; identify related files. Follow existing code patterns in the component. Keep changes minimal and focused. Add tests for new functionality. Update documentation if behavior changes. Run the full build: `npm run build`. Run tests: `npm run test`. Test manually if changing user-facing behavior. Write clear commit messages. Use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).

**Schema changes:** Update `docs/json-schema.json`, C++ `json_writer.cpp`, TypeScript `src/extension/src/types/`, Go `src/native-host/`. **Settings:** Chrome storage API, settings panel, service worker, `chrome.storage.sync`. **Manual integration:** `npm run build`; `npm run register:mapi` (admin); load extension in Chrome/Edge developer mode; check `%TEMP%\go-mapi\` and extension DevTools.
